about_the_game:
Fuu is a high-octane 2D Platformer Runner experience set in a gothic world governed by shadows and forgotten secrets. The game rewards fast reflexes, flawless timing, and a heart that welcomes challenge.

Take control of Fuu, our mysterious character whose eyes glow with light, and try to survive this eerie, seemingly endless, and trap-filled forest.

Gameplay Mechanics and Content Details

The game moves beyond a traditional runner, demanding you fluidly combine a set of essential platforming moves.

  • Core Movement System: Progress relies on the expert use of fundamental platforming actions such as the double jump, wall jump, and the crucial, quick-reaction precise dash/slide. Every section is meticulously designed to be conquered through seamless combinations of these movements.

  • Reflex Testing and Difficulty: Each level is packed with suddenly appearing traps, dynamic moving platforms, and small gaps designed to push your reflexes to the limit. When you fail, you instantly restart, engaging in a trial-and-error loop until you achieve the perfect run.

  • Mysterious Puzzle Elements: Speed alone won't suffice. To advance, you must solve small, trigger-based puzzles interspersed between platforming sequences. These elements require logical thinking, such as pressing buttons in the correct sequence or using precise timing to bypass a specific obstacle.

  • Progression and Goal: Your primary objective is to complete all challenging regions of the gothic forest and uncover the secret behind the mysterious light spheres surrounding the character. Each new region introduces increasing difficulty and unique mechanics, appealing directly to adventurous players.

Can you escape this dark and demanding realm?
